Download national GridMET files

Source: R/data_gridmet_bulk.R
download_gridmet_conus.Rd

Uses curl::multi_download(), which runs the transfers concurrently in one process (forked parallel downloads are unreliable on macOS), a few files at a time, and resumes partial files on re-run. Files that fail are reported, and the function can simply be called again.

Usage

download_gridmet_conus(
  vars = c("pr", "tmmn", "tmmx", "srad", "vs", "rmin", "rmax", "pet"),
  years = 1980:2024,
  dir = wsva_path("raw", "gridmet_conus"),
  n_parallel = 2,
  max_passes = 3
)

Arguments

vars

GridMET short names.

years

Calendar years.

dir

Destination folder.

n_parallel

Files downloaded at once (the server allows ~2).

max_passes

Retry passes for failed files.

Value

Tibble of var, year, path, ok.
